topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
consensus_response: On-board storage constraints prioritize immediate services over time-tagged ones, affecting power allocation. Buffer overflow mitigation strategies and adaptive coding schemes optimize transmission efficiency under constrained storage conditions, influencing load distribution and queue management.
reference_context: SatCom systems face trade-offs between capacity, latency, and priority due to on-board storage limits.
